notes:
REF-BM-02: Save fetches only the page title, not description, favicon, or preview image.
REF-BM-03: Title can be edited only after saving; description and pre-save editing are unavailable.
REF-BM-04: Only title and tags are editable; URL, description, and note are not represented.
REF-BM-07: List items show title and tags but omit description and favicon.
REF-BM-12: Search covers title, URL, and tags, but not description or note.
REF-BM-14: No #tag search syntax is parsed.
REF-BM-15: Boolean operators and parenthesised search expressions are unsupported.
REF-BM-16: Quoted exact-phrase syntax is unsupported.
REF-BM-20: There is no multi-selection or bulk-action facility.
REF-BM-21: There is no action applying to all bookmarks in the current filtered scope.
REF-BM-22: Bookmarks are fixed in newest-first order with no selectable sort key.
REF-BM-23: Bookmark notes and markdown rendering are absent.
REF-BM-24: Local HTML/PDF snapshots are absent.
REF-BM-25: Internet Archive snapshot creation is absent.
REF-BM-26: Bookmark archiving is absent.
REF-BM-27: Only permanent deletion exists; no reversible archive state is available.
REF-BM-28: There is no archived-bookmarks view.
REF-BM-29: Saved filter bundles are absent.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is absent.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is absent.
REF-BM-32: Display-related personal settings are absent.
